affiliations.date_precision: Roster dates cover the serviceman's federalized unit service; the accessible source does not establish the date or mechanism of any transfer to OSS.

affiliations.role_title: Professor of Hygiene and Public Health
affiliations.date_precision: Appointed instructor in 1924 and professor in 1932; a scholarly OSS history says his academic duties continued while he served on the R&A staff.

The source does not use an explicit 'recruited from' formula, so the temporal basis is strongly date-bounded rather than explicit-immediate.
